mapper.sql: plan_date, workshop, daily_plan_qty, daily_actual_qty, planned_completion, planned_completion_rate, cum_completion_qty, delayed_completion, unfinished_qty, cum_unfinished_qty, main_plan_qty, main_planned_completion, main_planned_completion_rate, urgent_unfinished_qty

WITH assy_order_workshop AS ( SELECT DISTINCT order_no, workshop FROM APS_ASSEMBLY_PLAN ), assy_plan AS ( SELECT order_no, workshop, TRUNC(SCHEDULE_TIME) AS plan_date, SUM(ASSEMBLY_QUANTITY) AS plan_qty FROM APS_ASSEMBLY_PLAN GROUP BY order_no, workshop, TRUNC(SCHEDULE_TIME) ), trans_raw AS ( SELECT order_no, TRUNC(INITIATOR_DATE) AS trans_date, SUM(QUANTITY) AS trans_qty FROM BUYER_PRODUCTION_TRANSFER WHERE QUANTITY > 0 GROUP BY order_no, TRUNC(INITIATOR_DATE) ), trans_assy AS ( SELECT t.order_no, ow.workshop, t.trans_date, t.trans_qty FROM trans_raw t JOIN assy_order_workshop ow ON t.order_no = ow.order_no ), total_trans_assy AS ( SELECT order_no, workshop, SUM(trans_qty) AS total_qty FROM trans_assy GROUP BY order_no, workshop ), plan_detail_assy AS ( SELECT p.order_no, p.workshop, p.plan_date, p.plan_qty, NVL(t.trans_qty, 0) AS trans_qty, SUM(p.plan_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY p.order_no, p.workshop ORDER BY p.plan_date) AS cum_plan, SUM(NVL(t.trans_qty, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.order_no, p.workshop ORDER BY p.plan_date) AS cum_trans, SUM(p.plan_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY p.order_no, p.workshop ORDER BY p.plan_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prev_cum_plan FROM assy_plan p LEFT JOIN trans_assy t ON p.order_no = t.order_no AND p.workshop = t.workshop AND p.plan_date = t.trans_date ), daily_agg_assy AS ( SELECT d.plan_date, d.workshop, SUM(d.plan_qty) AS daily_plan_qty, SUM(d.trans_qty) AS daily_actual_qty, SUM( CASE WHEN d.plan_qty > 0 THEN LEAST( GREATEST(0, d.trans_qty - GREATEST(COALESCE(d.prev_cum_plan,0) - (d.cum_trans - d.trans_qty), 0)), GREATEST(0, tt.total_qty - COALESCE(d.prev_cum_plan,0)), d.plan_qty ) ELSE 0 END ) AS planned_completion, SUM( GREATEST(0, LEAST(d.plan_qty, GREATEST(0, tt.total_qty - COALESCE(d.prev_cum_plan,0))) ) - CASE WHEN d.plan_qty > 0 THEN LEAST( GREATEST(0, d.trans_qty - GREATEST(COALESCE(d.prev_cum_plan,0) - (d.cum_trans - d.trans_qty), 0)), GREATEST(0, tt.total_qty - COALESCE(d.prev_cum_plan,0)), d.plan_qty ) ELSE 0 END ) AS delayed_completion, SUM( d.plan_qty - GREATEST(0, LEAST(d.plan_qty, GREATEST(0, tt.total_qty - COALESCE(d.prev_cum_plan,0))) ) ) AS unfinished_qty FROM plan_detail_assy d LEFT JOIN total_trans_assy tt ON d.order_no = tt.order_no AND d.workshop = tt.workshop WHERE d.plan_qty > 0 GROUP BY d.plan_date, d.workshop ), main_order_workshop AS ( SELECT DISTINCT production_order_no AS order_no, production_workshop AS workshop FROM aps_main_plan ), main_plan AS ( SELECT production_order_no AS order_no, production_workshop AS workshop, TRUNC(SCHEDULED_DATE) AS plan_date, SUM(SCHEDULED_QUANTITY) AS plan_qty FROM aps_main_plan GROUP BY production_order_no, production_workshop, TRUNC(SCHEDULED_DATE) ), trans_main AS ( SELECT t.order_no, ow.workshop, t.trans_date, t.trans_qty FROM trans_raw t JOIN main_order_workshop ow ON t.order_no = ow.order_no ), total_trans_main AS ( SELECT order_no, workshop, SUM(trans_qty) AS total_qty FROM trans_main GROUP BY order_no, workshop ), plan_detail_main AS ( SELECT p.order_no, p.workshop, p.plan_date, p.plan_qty, NVL(t.trans_qty, 0) AS trans_qty, SUM(p.plan_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY p.order_no, p.workshop ORDER BY p.plan_date) AS cum_plan, SUM(NVL(t.trans_qty, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.order_no, p.workshop ORDER BY p.plan_date) AS cum_trans, SUM(p.plan_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY p.order_no, p.workshop ORDER BY p.plan_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prev_cum_plan FROM main_plan p LEFT JOIN trans_main t ON p.order_no = t.order_no AND p.workshop = t.workshop AND p.plan_date = t.trans_date ), daily_agg_main AS ( SELECT d.plan_date, d.workshop, SUM(d.plan_qty) AS main_plan_qty, SUM( CASE WHEN d.plan_qty > 0 THEN LEAST( GREATEST(0, d.trans_qty - GREATEST(COALESCE(d.prev_cum_plan,0) - (d.cum_trans - d.trans_qty), 0)), GREATEST(0, tt.total_qty - COALESCE(d.prev_cum_plan,0)), d.plan_qty ) ELSE 0 END ) AS main_planned_completion FROM plan_detail_main d LEFT JOIN total_trans_main tt ON d.order_no = tt.order_no AND d.workshop = tt.workshop WHERE d.plan_qty > 0 GROUP BY d.plan_date, d.workshop ), urgent_main_plan AS ( SELECT production_order_no AS order_no, production_workshop AS workshop, TRUNC(SCHEDULED_DATE) AS plan_date, SUM(SCHEDULED_QUANTITY) AS plan_qty FROM aps_main_plan WHERE URGENCY_LEVEL IS NOT NULL GROUP BY production_order_no, production_workshop, TRUNC(SCHEDULED_DATE) ), urgent_order_workshop AS ( SELECT DISTINCT order_no, workshop FROM urgent_main_plan ), trans_urgent AS ( SELECT t.order_no, ow.workshop, t.trans_date, t.trans_qty FROM trans_raw t JOIN urgent_order_workshop ow ON t.order_no = ow.order_no ), total_trans_urgent AS ( SELECT order_no, workshop, SUM(trans_qty) AS total_qty FROM trans_urgent GROUP BY order_no, workshop ), plan_detail_urgent AS ( SELECT p.order_no, p.workshop, p.plan_date, p.plan_qty, NVL(t.trans_qty, 0) AS trans_qty, SUM(p.plan_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY p.order_no, p.workshop ORDER BY p.plan_date) AS cum_plan, SUM(NVL(t.trans_qty, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.order_no, p.workshop ORDER BY p.plan_date) AS cum_trans, SUM(p.plan_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY p.order_no, p.workshop ORDER BY p.plan_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prev_cum_plan FROM urgent_main_plan p LEFT JOIN trans_urgent t ON p.order_no = t.order_no AND p.workshop = t.workshop AND p.plan_date = t.trans_date ), urgent_daily_agg AS ( SELECT d.plan_date, d.workshop, SUM(d.plan_qty) AS urgent_plan_qty, SUM( CASE WHEN d.plan_qty > 0 THEN LEAST( GREATEST(0, d.trans_qty - GREATEST(COALESCE(d.prev_cum_plan,0) - (d.cum_trans - d.trans_qty), 0)), GREATEST(0, tt.total_qty - COALESCE(d.prev_cum_plan,0)), d.plan_qty ) ELSE 0 END ) AS urgent_planned_completion FROM plan_detail_urgent d LEFT JOIN total_trans_urgent tt ON d.order_no = tt.order_no AND d.workshop = tt.workshop WHERE d.plan_qty > 0 GROUP BY d.plan_date, d.workshop ), all_dates_workshops AS ( SELECT plan_date, workshop FROM daily_agg_assy UNION SELECT plan_date, workshop FROM daily_agg_main UNION SELECT plan_date, workshop FROM urgent_daily_agg ), urgent_unfinished AS ( SELECT plan_date, workshop, GREATEST( SUM(urgent_plan_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY workshop ORDER BY plan_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) - SUM(urgent_planned_completion) OVER (PARTITION BY workshop ORDER BY plan_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 0 ) AS urgent_unfinished_qty FROM urgent_daily_agg ) SELECT ad.plan_date, ad.workshop, NVL(da.daily_plan_qty, 0) AS daily_plan_qty, NVL(da.daily_actual_qty, 0) AS daily_actual_qty, NVL(da.planned_completion, 0) AS planned_completion, ROUND(NVL(da.planned_completion, 0) / NULLIF(NVL(da.daily_plan_qty, 0), 0) * 100, 2) AS planned_completion_rate, SUM(NVL(da.daily_actual_qty, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY ad.workshop ORDER BY ad.plan_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_completion_qty, NVL(da.delayed_completion, 0) AS delayed_completion, NVL(da.unfinished_qty, 0) AS unfinished_qty, SUM(NVL(da.unfinished_qty, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY ad.workshop ORDER BY ad.plan_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_unfinished_qty, NVL(dm.main_plan_qty, 0) AS main_plan_qty, NVL(dm.main_planned_completion, 0) AS main_planned_completion, ROUND(NVL(dm.main_planned_completion, 0) / NULLIF(NVL(dm.main_plan_qty, 0), 0) * 100, 2) AS main_planned_completion_rate, NVL(ug.urgent_unfinished_qty, 0) AS urgent_unfinished_qty FROM all_dates_workshops ad LEFT JOIN daily_agg_assy da ON ad.plan_date = da.plan_date AND ad.workshop = da.workshop LEFT JOIN daily_agg_main dm ON ad.plan_date = dm.plan_date AND ad.workshop = dm.workshop LEFT JOIN urgent_unfinished ug ON ad.plan_date = ug.plan_date AND ad.workshop = ug.workshop
AND ad.plan_date >= #{beginPlanDate} AND ad.plan_date <= #{endPlanDate} AND ad.workshop = #{workshop}
